rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the moderation in core inflation to 4.10%, the headline CPI at 5.55% remains uncomfortably close to the upper tolerance threshold. The persistence of food inflation at 8.70%, exacerbated by the 6.0% monsoon deficit, poses a significant risk of unanchoring inflation expectations. With a positive output gap of 0.60%, the economy is operating above potential, and any premature shift in stance could be misconstrued as a dilution of our commitment to the 4.00% target. I remain firm that the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is necessary to ensure full monetary transmission and to guard against potential second-round effects from supply-side shocks.
